description: This file defines the CordRepRing class, a data structure for managing ring buffers of CordRep nodes, including methods for creation, modification, and querying of ring buffers used in string data management within the Abseil library.

classes.name: CordRepRing
classes.description: A class representing a ring buffer of CordRep nodes, supporting operations like append, prepend, subring extraction, and removal of suffix/prefix, optimized for string data management.

classes.name: CordRep::Position
classes.description: A struct representing a position within a CordRepRing, including node index and offset.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates a new CordRepRing from a child CordRep with specified extra capacity.

methods.name: Append
methods.description: Appends a CordRep or string data to the ring buffer.

methods.name: Prepend
methods.description: Prepends a CordRep or string data to the ring buffer.

methods.name: SubRing
methods.description: Returns a subring of the current ring starting at offset with specified length.

methods.name: RemoveSuffix
methods.description: Removes the last 'len' bytes from the ring buffer.

methods.name: RemovePrefix
methods.description: Removes the first 'len' bytes from the ring buffer.

methods.name: GetCharacter
methods.description: Returns the character at a specific offset within the ring.

methods.name: IsFlat
methods.description: Checks if the ring manages a single contiguous buffer.

methods.name: Find
methods.description: Finds the position corresponding to a specific offset.

methods.name: FindTail
methods.description: Finds the tail position for a given offset.
